description: Combine KPI cards, charts, maps and short notes into ONE image, in rows (1-4 rows, 1-4 panels per row, at most 8 panels). For weekly email updates, Slack posts, client reports and slides. Each panel is a chart definition with its 'type' (kpi, line, column, bar, pie, area, country-map, world-map, county-map, small-multiples, or note for a sentence of text: {type:'note', text}). Typical: a row of KPI cards, then a trend chart beside a map or a top-10 bar chart, then a note with the takeaway. For a multi-page document with text use create_report instead. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

rows.description: Rows of panels, top to bottom; each panel like {"type":"line","title":"…","data":[…]}.
